title: Bamboo Partition
statementMd:
Vladimir wants to modernize partitions in his office. To make the office more comfortable he decided to remove a partition and plant several bamboos in a row. He thinks it would be nice if there are $*n*$ bamboos in a row, and the $*i*$-th from the left is $*a*_{*i*}$ meters high.

Vladimir has just planted $*n*$ bamboos in a row, each of which has height $0$ meters right now, but they grow $1$ meter each day. In order to make the partition nice Vladimir can cut each bamboo once at any height (no greater that the height of the bamboo), and then the bamboo will stop growing.

Vladimir wants to check the bamboos each $*d*$ days (i.e. $*d*$ days after he planted, then after $2*d*$ days and so on), and cut the bamboos that reached the required height. Vladimir wants the total length of bamboo parts he will cut off to be no greater than $*k*$ meters.

What is the maximum value $*d*$ he can choose so that he can achieve what he wants without cutting off more than $*k*$ meters of bamboo?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{11}$) — the number of bamboos and the maximum total length of cut parts, in meters.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the required heights of bamboos, in meters.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum value of $*d*$ such that Vladimir can reach his goal.

## Note

In the first example Vladimir can check bamboos each $3$ days. Then he will cut the first and the second bamboos after $3$ days, and the third bamboo after $6$ days. The total length of cut parts is $2 + 0 + 1 = 3$ meters.
statementZhMd:
Vladimir 想要对办公室里的隔断进行现代化改造。为了让办公室更加舒适，他决定拆除一面隔断，并在一排中种植若干根竹子。他认为，如果一排中有 $*n*$ 根竹子，且从左数第 $*i*$ 根竹子的高度为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 米，那将会很不错。

Vladimir 刚刚在一排中种下了 $*n*$ 根竹子，现在每根竹子的高度都是 $0$ 米，但它们每天会长高 $1$ 米。为了使隔断美观，Vladimir 可以将每根竹子切割一次，切割高度可以任意选择（但不能高于竹子当前的高度），切割后竹子将停止生长。

Vladimir 想每隔 $*d*$ 天检查一次竹子（也就是种下竹子 $*d*$ 天后检查一次，然后在 $2*d*$ 天后再次检查，依此类推），并切割已经达到所需高度的竹子。Vladimir 希望他切下的竹子部分的总长度不超过 $*k*$ 米。

他所能选择的 $*d*$ 的最大值是多少，使得 Vladimir 能够在切下的竹子部分总长度不超过 $*k*$ 米的情况下实现目标？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{11}$）——竹子的数量和允许切下部分的最大总长度，单位为米。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——每根竹子所需的高度，单位为米。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Vladimir 能够实现目标的 $*d*$ 的最大值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vladimir 可以每 $3$ 天检查一次竹子。这样，他会在 $3$ 天后切割第一根和第二根竹子，并在 $6$ 天后切割第三根竹子。切下的竹子部分的总长度为 $2 + 0 + 1 = 3$ 米。
